title: eremanthus goyazensis
intro: Eremanthus goyazensis, commonly known as "Goyaz Herb", is a plant species native to Brazil, which belongs to the family Asteraceae. The Goyaz Herb has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Its therapeutic actions may include protecting against oxidative stress, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Eremanthus goyazensis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
